name: Altenahr (Germany)
description: Vertically divided white and red, the white hoist charged with the municipal arms of Altenahr (a red eagle and a black cross on white).
history: Municipal flag of Altenahr; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Altenahr arms — eagle and cross on white
